summary: Copies the current vehicle's scene name into an output buffer with a length limit. When the output buffer is non-null it is cleared, the vehicle name is taken from this+0x8 (fallback byte_5EA438) and resolved via VehicleLookupByName, then the current vehicle is fetched via CurrentVehicleAccessor on unk_8AC388. If a vehicle is found and the buffer size a3 is > 1, the scene-name string at vehicle+124 is copied through sub_587DD0 with limit a3-1 and the buffer is null-terminated at a3-1.
